description: Create a free RankFuel leaderboard (rnkfl.com) for radio listeners, no account needed: a public board for an on-air contest (call-ins, trivia, check-ins). Returns the public board URL, studio-screen URL and website embed (URL + iframe HTML), plus a SECRET manage token/URL in the "secret" block: give it only to the person running the board, never post it. Limits: 5 new boards per 10 minutes and 20 per day per connection; up to 500 listeners per board. Free, no key.

color.description: Optional brand colour as hex, e.g. #e65208 (default #3dd879)

logoUrl.description: Optional https:// link to the station logo image

station.description: Station name or call sign, e.g. "CFAX 1070" (max 80 characters)

name: create_leaderboard
